        for j in range(n):

            if int(s[j]) != want:
                acc += c[j]

    suf = [[0]*(n+2) for _ in range(2)]

            cost = pre[b][i] + suf[1-b][i]
            if best is None or cost < best:

    # f[p][j] for 0-indexed j; pattern value = (j+1 + p) % 2 for 1-indexed j
    f = [[0]*n for _ in range(2)]
    for p in range(2):
        for j in range(n):
            val = (j + 1 + p) % 2
            if int(s[j]) != val:
                f[p][j] = c[j]
    # prefix sums
    pre = [[0]*(n+1) for _ in range(2)]
    for p in range(2):
        for j in range(n):
            pre[p][j+1] = pre[p][j] + f[p][j]
    total = [pre[0][n], pre[1][n]]
    best = None
    # boundary after 1-indexed i: prefix is positions 1..i (0-indexed 0..i-1), suffix is i..n-1
    for i in range(1, n):
        for p in range(2):
            q = 1 - p
            cost = pre[p][i] + (total[q] - pre[q][i])
            if best is None or cost < best:
                best = cost
    print(best)
